latest.name: Auphonic — AI Audio Post-Production & Leveling
latest.category: Hidden gems from any AI category
latest.short_verdict: Auphonic is a browser-based AI audio post-production service for cleaning noisy recordings, balancing speech and music levels, removing filler pauses, and normalizing loudness. The free tier includes 2 hours of processing every month with the core audio algorithms and no card required, but free outputs contain an Auphonic jingle. It is best for speech-heavy audio and voiceovers, not a replacement for a DAW or creative music mastering.
latest.what_it_does: Auphonic applies machine-learning and audio-processing algorithms to uploaded audio or video. Its core tools include noise and reverb reduction, adaptive loudness leveling between speakers and music, filtering and voice enhancement, clipping/codec repair, filler-word and silence cutting, loudness normalization to standards such as EBU R128, and multitrack mixing. It is designed for podcasts, interviews, narration, education, radio and video dialogue; it can help prepare spoken intros, voice tags and voiceovers, but it is not a full music-production or sound-design workstation.
latest.why_try_it: It can turn a rough speech recording into a more even, cleaner track without manually building a compressor, EQ and denoising chain. A practical test is to upload a short voiceover or spoken intro, compare the original and processed audio, and keep the final mix in your usual editor. The recurring 2-hour free allowance makes it useful for occasional work, provided the added jingle and privacy terms are acceptable.
latest.free_tier: Auphonic Free provides 2 hours of processed audio per month, including its AI-based audio algorithms. The free allowance resets monthly and unused credits do not stack. Free users can use Intelligent Leveler, Noise & Reverb Reduction, Filtering & Enhancement, Loudness Specifications, and filler/silence cutting. The official homepage says free signup needs only an email address and no credit card. Free productions include an Auphonic jingle.
latest.limits: Free multitrack productions are limited to under 20 minutes per production. Multilingual speech recognition, automatic show notes/chapters, watch folders and batch productions are not included in Free. The service bills by input-audio duration with a 3-minute minimum per production, so very short files can consume at least 3 minutes. Unused monthly free credits do not roll over. Free outputs include an Auphonic jingle. Auphonic is not a replacement for a DAW, detailed sound design or final creative music mastering. Privacy caveat: its Terms and Privacy Policy say uploaded media is stored for processing and may be retained in selected excerpts to improve algorithms; employees or contractors may listen to content for that purpose. Audio productions are normally deleted after 21 days and video after 7 days. Business customers can request a training opt-out; keep confidential client recordings out unless the data terms are acceptable.
latest.signup_pakistan: Auphonic's public Terms of Service and registration page checked on 2026-11-21 did not identify Pakistan as a blocked country. Registration offers email, Google or Apple sign-in, and the vendor says the free tier does not require payment details. Pakistan-based signup and access were not independently tested. Paid checkout acceptance for Pakistani cards or local payment methods was not verified.
latest.quality_evidence: Vendor claim: Auphonic's homepage says it is used by 2M+ people and displays customer logos including BBC radio, Buzzsprout, iHeartRadio and MSNBC; this is company-reported adoption, not an independently audited user count. It also publishes testimonials from the Lex Fridman Podcast, Tom Scott, ORF and other production teams. Independent user-review signal: G2 lists 4.2/5 from 10 reviews, a small sample; reviewers praise ease of use and audio quality, while some mention pricing. Anecdotal community feedback: a May 2025 r/podcasting user said Auphonic performed best after trying five audio-cleanup tools; other Reddit users also report useful cleanup, but these are individual experiences. No standardized independent audio benchmark for Auphonic was located.
latest.android_status: An official Android companion app, Auphonic Edit, is listed on Google Play by Auphonic. It is primarily an offline recorder and non-destructive editor that can export recordings to the Auphonic web service; it is not the full AI post-production service in a native Android app. Google Play lists its last update as 2017-05-08. Pakistan-specific Play Store availability was not verified.
